summary_1line: Pulastya describes the supreme sanctity of Kurukshetra and numerous surrounding tirthas, detailing the spiritual merits gained by pilgrimage, ritual bathing, and offerings.

image_candidates.scene_text: At Rudrakoti, Shiva multiplies himself into countless forms so that every assembled sage beholds him at once.
Parashurama stands beside five lakes he filled with the blood of slain Kshatriyas while offering oblations to his ancestors.
Pilgrims walk across the dusty plains of Kurukshetra as wind lifts sacred dust believed to cleanse all sins.
